title: feat(studio): Save and Cancel in the item header, the AI assistant at the end of every title row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgTC1DCWJ4MisoLdbUU1V1sb)_

Fixes #37455

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio 里改对象、流程、权限集等时，「取消 / 保存」出现在详情页头的右侧；AI 助手按钮（没有 AI 时是右侧栏开关）出现在每个页面标题行的最右边，和前端应用的页头一样；顶栏不再有这几个按钮。
- 为什么做：App Studio 改版要去掉顶栏，这几个按钮先搬到新家（父卡里你选的「按推荐启动」）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个页面找不到保存或 AI 按钮（快捷键仍可开关右侧栏），不丢数据，撤回这个改动即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。石墨色挂到整个 Studio 要等左侧菜单那张卡（定义石墨色）合入后，在本 PR 里补上，补上之前保持草稿。

## What changes

The Studio top bar's page controls move to the open page's own title row. The surface still owns and builds them (save coordinator, right slot, robot control); only their place changes, so their logic is untouched and the two cards that change the save controls next (#37440, #36660) rebase onto `studioSaveBar.tsx` unchanged.

- **New `studioTitleRow.tsx`.** `StudioTitleRowProvider` (mounted by `StudioDesignSurface`) hands the rendered controls to the page's title rows. Every title row registers its row element, and only the first in document order draws the controls, so a page never draws two Saves (a header nested in the page's own, or an embedded compact row, draws nothing). Outside the surface nothing is drawn, so Setup's metadata pages are unchanged.
- **Cancel and Save** end `StudioItemHeader`'s right-aligned action slot, after the pillar's actions (the detail header's ‹ ›, primary button and ⋯). Per the area PM's increment (ADR-0084 amendment draft, PR #37470), a page that saves with no item header ends its own title row with them (`StudioTitleRowEnd`).
- **The AI assistant** (or, with no copilot served, the right slot's show / hide icon) ends every title row behind a hairline, as `PageHeader` ends with the shell's button group (#36111): the item header, the list page's title row (`PageShell`, list and compact rows, not when embedded), the directory and diagnostics headers.
- **The top bar** loses only those controls. Its other tenants, including "create app" / "app waits for publish", Changes and Publish, are untouched (#37456 removes the bar; #37454 moves Publish).
- **Not in this head yet: the graphite accent on the Studio root.** It consumes `STUDIO_ACCENT` from #37452, which is not on `main` (that branch has no PR yet). Per the dispatch, this PR merges `main` once after #37452 lands and mounts the class on the Studio root (the `StudioMenuProvider` frame), with the card's "a non-default app theme does not tint Studio" pin. It stays draft until then.

## Tests

- `StudioDesignSurface.saveBar-36511`: re-pointed, not weakened. Cancel and Save are asserted inside the object page's item header (`data-object-header`), absent from the top bar, drawn exactly once, and Save is still the last action (only the assistant follows). The draft case still asserts Changes and Publish in the top bar and that Publish waits for Save.
- `StudioDesignSurface.rightSlot-12725`: a new top-level describe. On the sharing overview the AI assistant ends the item header behind the hairline, is absent from the top bar, and still hides and shows the slot. On a list page it ends the list's title row, inside the page.
- `studioTitleRow.test.tsx` (new): the order in an item header (pillar actions, Save, hairline, assistant); no hairline with nothing before it; nested and later rows draw nothing (one Save, one assistant); the outer header of a nested pair wins; the next row takes over when the first goes; a page with no item header ends its own row with Save; and the control: outside the surface nothing is drawn.
- Reverse verification: with `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `StudioItemHeader.tsx` and `PageShell.tsx` restored to the base commit, 9 of the 13 new or re-pointed cases go red (the 4 that stay green are the outside-the-surface control and the unchanged slot cases); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- At 6be30eed: the 242 app-shell suites that name the moved controls, the item or detail header, `PageShell`, the directory, diagnostics or list pages, or the save harness: `Test Files 242 passed (242)`, `Tests 2052 passed (2052)`.
- At 7c9bb160 (the registry keyed by a token, no state set in an effect): the three suites above plus `pillarsClaimSlot-12725`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.partialSave-36511` and `AutomationsPillar.saveCancel-36511`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 39 passed (39)`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (sources and the test project): exit 0.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): see the report on the card.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Pages with no title row in a package scope (the loading state, a not-found page) draw no assistant; `⌘.` still opens and switches the slot there.
- Dialogs, menus, sheets and toasts are portalled to the document body, outside the Studio root, so a root mount of the accent will not reach them; recorded for the accent commit.
- The directory and diagnostics headers are outside `studio-design/`; they are the "list title row" of their pages and get one line each.

## Verification

Read first: `studioTitleRow.tsx` (the one-owner registry), the `StudioItemHeader` action-slot hunk, the `StudioDesignSurface` hunk that builds `titleRowSave` / `titleRowAssistant`.

Two-minute check: open an object in a package's Studio (`/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/object/NAME`), add a field: Cancel and Save appear at the right of the object's header, and the robot sits at the far right after a hairline; the top bar shows neither.
